findings.label: Acceptance tests require graph mocking
findings.description: J1–J3 tests call graph.run() as async but the graph invocation is synchronous. Tests will fail with 'coroutine never awaited' or similar errors without refactoring or mocking.

findings.label: Eval harness missing
findings.description: eval_harness_s2.py referenced in the plan does not exist. Phase 9 evaluation cannot proceed without it.

findings.label: Golden evaluation set missing
findings.description: No unified jsonl file with 50+ evaluation records meeting Phase 9 schema requirements exists. Scattered v0 jsonl files predate Phase 9 requirements.

findings.label: Entity extraction skips linker integration
findings.description: RuleBasedEntityExtractor does not call EntityLinker during extraction, leaving linked_id null on all entities. EntityValidator will reject every entity at the cross-tenant check, blocking all tool binding.

findings.label: Graph run() mixes async/sync paradigms
findings.description: TriageAgentGraph.run() is declared async but calls self.graph.invoke() (synchronous). This causes paradigm mismatch and acceptance test failures.
